subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for `requireMention` channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits must it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silently processing unmentioned speech changes privacy/security and configuration policy rather than only repairing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for a shared media-history policy
options.body: Keep this issue open as product input and avoid a Discord-only knob until maintainers define cross-channel media retention semantics.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should never be transcribed or retained without a direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across Discord preflight/config policy and the related audio hardening path.
